stem:
The table shows the checking account fees at two banks.

Checking Account Fees

| Type of Fee            | Bank Q (dollars) | Bank R (dollars) |
|-----------------------|------------------|------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee | 6                | 5                |
| Overdraft fee per check | 10               | 15               |

A customer has a checking account for 5 months and writes 3 checks for amounts greater than the checking account balance. Which statement correctly compares the fees that Bank Q and Bank R will charge the customer?

options.label: A
options.text: The total fees charged by Bank Q will be $10 less than those charged by Bank R.

options.label: B
options.text: The total fees charged by Bank Q will be $22 less than those charged by Bank R.

options.label: C
options.text: The total fees charged by Bank Q will be $4 less than those charged by Bank R.

options.label: D
options.text: The total fees charged by Bank Q will be the same as those charged by Bank R.

visual_elements: The table titled 'Checking Account Fees' showing two rows of fees for Bank Q and Bank R.
